label: preparing
what: Innkeeper, builder and freight are jointly preparing an eighteen-o'clock great-hall gathering, including bread refreshments, deliveries and lighting. Baker knowingly supplies the bread (120 original loaves plus 80 additional loaves paid for by builder); secretary arranges my appointment and escort. Preparations clearly exist, but I have been told about the gathering and approved attendance. Its particular occasion remains undisclosed; there is insufficient evidence to call it a surprise celebration or a bridge/port scheme. Neighbour appears to be an inquisitive prospective guest, not a knowing helper in an undisclosed plan. Probability given concerns an additional undisclosed purpose behind these preparations, not the well-established gathering itself.
